answer: Each agent earns a reputation token stamped with a unique juniper‑seed identifier after completing a verified voyage of task proofs. Tokens are vouch‑linked in a directed web‑of‑trust; when a node is exposed as a sybil, a gale of revocation sweeps its inbound vouchers, dropping their standing to zero. An attacker must therefore buy enough authentic tokens to survive cascading revocations, costing proportional to the total network stake.
